comment: Prof. Henry is one of the best that I've had. He gives you great feedback and the way that the class is structured, you get feedback from all your classmates. Your grade is mostly participation, and some projects at the end. There is some reading required that you should keep up with, but overall I LOVED this class and helped me improve so much.
Really great guy, super caring about student's work. Gives very genuine feedback. One of the best professors I've ever had, has made my writing 10x better.

Professor Henry is my favorite professor I've had at UR. I've taken two of his classes and will definitely try to fit another one into a future schedule. He's funny, caring, and always makes for a fun class in general. I've learned a lot about how to be a better writer from him, and I recommend him to everyone I know.

Professor Henry is the best! He truly wants all his students to succeed and finds ways to make positive, constructive comments on every piece students write. Class is structured in a rotation: one day reviewing new literary styles / pieces, and then two days peer reviewing student-written pieces in those styles. Would take anything he taught!

I highly recommend taking Lit Translation w Prof. Henry, even if you don't speak a 2nd language. The class is very collaborative + the workload is manageable. I've taken classes with him before and it is always a pleasure. He is passionate about the subject and it truly shows. He is very understanding and is always available outside of class.

Prof. Henry is pretty laid back, but can come off as not caring sometimes. He can be friendly and crack jokes but usually only with the students that he knows previously. You are graded only on a few things and 65% of your grade comes from your final portfolio and an anthology (finals) so you wont know your grade until final grades come out.

Professor Henry creates an environment where students have the flexibility to express themselves and write what they want while encouraging them to try new styles. The feedback, guidance and exposure to short readings really develop your skills. If you're a serious writer or just write for fun, take this class!

Prof Henry is a great guy. Class is extremely laid back, and by the end of the semester you will grow so much as writer. His feedback is clear and straightforward. No complaints whatsoever. If you hand in your assignments and show up on time you'll have a wonderful semester.

I took Professor Henry for creative writing and loved him! The work load is very light and often times you'd be let out of class early. He is a very easy going professor and fun to be around. I recommend this class if you are into writing but be aware that it does not fill the gen ed requirement!!!
Amazingly helpful for students looking to be publishing in poetry. Very accessible. Class can drag on a little bit.

Professor Henry really knows his stuff when it comes to poetry. His comments helped me improve my writing, and the assigned readings (10 new books of poetry) gave me a good sense of what published poets are doing now. He lets students write whatever they want but encourages trying different styles.

Class can be kind of dry sometimes but Professor Henry is very relaxed. There are no tests just short 1 -2 page papers. If you do the work that's asked of you and participate this class is an easy A. I suggest doing the assigned readings in small chunks each day and keeping up with your poetry diary.
The final project is worth 40% of your grade. Start it early and you'll be fine. Loved the class and loved the professor.
Gave honest feedback on my creative writing assignments. Go to class, put effort into your writing, and participate. He's an awesome professor.

Like another reviewer, I also took the portfolio class, wrote fiction, and found the class lacking.  It wasn't so much the amount I was expected to write.  It was that whenever I went to Professor Henry for feedback, he was unavailable.  On almost 70 pages of my writing, he left 100 words of comments.  A wasted semester, unfortunately.

I took a writing portfolio class. He expected us to write an entire novel over the course of the semester. He didn't take into account that we had other classes. In addition to the novel, we had to write ten (!) papers on books we read.  If you take him, write poetry. Even bad poetry, he'll love it. DON'T WRITE FICTION!
He's super cool and definitely knows what he's talking about!

Dr. Henry is amazing!! If he's teaching and FYS take it immediately.   His laid-back teaching style mixed with his love for the material make his class interesting.  I actually looked forward to spending an hour and fifteen minute with Dr. Henry.
He's a cool guy. Brightens up the room and is very open to new opinions. Cuts through the jargon and gives you the meat of the passage after the class is done discussing.
No Comments

Professor Henry is the kind of guy students want to hang out with. Very chill and laid back. Students who want to get published at some point can learn a lot from him. Even for non-writers his intro creative writing class is awesome and easy.
